'''Blacaa Maralt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] living in the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blacaa Maralt appears as the underworld trading trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
